mainEntity.name: What if my provider has not reported my hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the provider first. Most report within a few business days; near the deadline, ask for confirmation before you attempt to renew.

mainEntity.name: Can I carry over extra hours to next year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Continuing education hours count for the renewal period in which they were completed.
Renew during the late window, November 1 through January 15, with the late fee. After January 15 the registration lapses.

mainEntity.name: Do I need the same provider every year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can change providers each year; only CTEC approval matters.
Complete a 60-hour qualifying education course and register again as a new preparer, including the background check.
